summary: Travel + Leisure Co. filed an 8-K regarding a $900M private offering of 6.250% senior secured notes due 2031. Net proceeds will redeem all $650M of its outstanding 6.625% secured notes due July 2026, repay borrowings under its secured revolver, and for general corporate purposes. The offering is expected to close May 20, 2026, with redemption conditioned on consummation. This is a liability management transaction, restructuring debt capital rather than an acquisition or divestiture. Watch for closing conditions and redemption execution.
